pull: Clue: Crews called it the Beast
body:
Can you name this aircraft?

On 11 November 1943, this dive bomber flew its first combat mission, launched from the carrier USS Bunker Hill against the Japanese stronghold at Rabaul. The Navy had demanded hundreds of design changes before it would accept the plane, and crews never quite forgave its tricky handling.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
photoNote: SB2C-4 Helldivers of VB-3 from USS Yorktown (CV-10) over the invasion fleet off Iwo Jima, February 1945 (Commons gives 19 to 22 Feb 1945). U.S. Navy photo 80-G-304753, public domain. Later variant and squadron than the VB-17 SB2C-1s that flew the 11 Nov 1943 Rabaul debut; side numbers 110 and 107 do not name the type.
photoCredit: SB2C-4 Helldivers from USS Yorktown over the invasion fleet off Iwo Jima, February 1945. U.S. Navy 80-G-304753, public domain.
